notes.title: Bug fix Vr1.01
notes.content:
Hello, fellow Cartoon Cagematch fans!!!
Here is a small update for the game

1. Lifesteal bumped up from [b]10%[/b]-> [b]20%[/b]
2. Bazooka has an explosion effect
3. Enemies slower
4. More difficult enemies give more XP

Happy gaming :)

notes.title: We are working on a small update for the game
notes.content:
After playing the game for 62 hours I did find 1 bug and 1 thing to make the game a little more user freindly.
-vampirism perk will now work with melee builds
-after wave 4 enemies will be slowed down so you can earn more upgrade points
-Rpg explosion animation will be added

Thats all that is planned for the time being.  update should be out in a few days.
